title: Scaffold at a glance
lede: Scaffold gives AI coding agents shared skills, rules and workflows. Click any skill for its own page; each page starts high level and drills down to the full detail.

lanes.name: Run the work
lanes.sub: who does what, and how work keeps moving

orchestration.name: Orchestration
orchestration.role: One orchestrator per session owns the plan and the branch; subagents do one task each in their own worktree.

queue.name: Queue
queue.role: A visible, editable task list that agents drain one task at a time or in parallel.

loop.name: Loop tick
loop.role: The heartbeat that picks the next queue task and keeps work moving.

continuity.name: Save, pause, resume
continuity.role: Checkpoint a long session into git so it survives a close and resumes anywhere.

feature.name: Feature chain
feature.role: Design, PRD, TDD, refine and QA, ending in a PR for the owner.

tdd.name: TDD
tdd.role: Build in thin vertical slices: failing test, minimal code, refactor.

pr.name: PR workflow
pr.role: One task per PR, real CI checks, squash merge only with owner approval.

gates.name: Review gates
gates.role: Independent correctness and structure reviews, one fix pass, re-verified.

qa.name: QA
qa.role: Drive the real app the way a user would and fix what breaks.

investigate.name: Investigate
investigate.role: Find the root cause before changing code.

prune.name: Prune
prune.role: Run every quality lens, then fix the findings through the feature chain.

linter.name: Add linter
linter.role: Add linter configs and CI workflows for each language in a repo.

sync.name: Scaffold sync
sync.role: Sync skills down to consumer repos, upstream improvements, hoist skills out.

skillify.name: Skillify
skillify.role: Turn finished work into a reusable, registered skill.

retro.name: Retro
retro.role: An evidence-backed look back at a session that proposes concrete fixes.

council.name: Council
council.role: Five advisors, anonymous peer review and a chairman verdict for hard decisions.

mindmeld.name: Mind meld
mindmeld.role: A repo-owned learning IDE built from code indexes and real runs.

voice.name: Voice chat
voice.role: A hands-free voice loop with the coding agent.

flows.name: Build a feature
flows.intro: The usual path for a piece of work.
steps: Feature started on the working branch

ask.context: The reader wants an overview of scaffold, a template that gives AI coding agents shared skills, rules and workflows, and how its skills fit together.
